It is obtainable via the [[rare drop table]]. A player with level 93 [[Smithing]] can make the shield by using two [[rune bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 150 [[experience]]. Rune square shields can also be obtained from [[Magpie impling jar]]s as well as a common drop from a [[Greater Nechryael]]. Any monster that has access to the [[rare drop table]] can also drop the rune square shield. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -6 |arange = 0 |dstab = +38 |dslash = +40 |dcrush = +36 |dmagic = 0 |drange = +38 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Rune sq shield equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Rune sq shield equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 93 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 150 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 2 |output1 = Rune sq shield }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune sq shield}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Rune sq shield}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Rune sq shield}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The shield's ranged attack bonus has been increased from -2 to 0. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 5 October -
